description: Self-hosted semantic memory for AI agents, served over MCP. Persistent sessions, experience scoring, a graveyard for dead ends and skills compiled from what worked, plus knowledge from the RSS feeds you read. One Rust binary on SQLite: a tray app for macOS, Windows and Linux, or a server.
summary: Self-hosted semantic memory for AI Agents. Persistent sessions, experience scoring, and a graveyard for dead ends, backed by knowledge acquired from the RSS you read and stored in a Valkey vector search then exposed as an MCP server.
